title: Zesty Polish Flour Flatbread
description: A fluffy, citrusy flatbread with a romantic Polish twist, finished with a fragrant tadka and completely sugar‑free friendly.
instructions: In a bowl, combine warm water and yeast; let sit 2–3 minutes until frothy.
Add flour, salt, lemon zest, lemon juice, dried basil, and 1 tbsp olive oil to the yeast mixture. Stir until a shaggy dough forms.
Turn dough onto a floured surface and knead for 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 60 minutes or until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough, divide into 4 equal portions, and shape each into a round flatbread about 15 cm in diameter.
Preheat oven to 220 °C (428 °F) with a baking stone or steel if available.
Bake flatbreads on the stone for 12–15 minutes, or until golden brown and puffed.
While baking, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Add cumin seeds, red chili flakes, and minced garlic; sauté for 1–2 minutes until fragrant.
Brush the hot tadka over the freshly baked flatbreads and serve immediately.
For an extra citrus kick, drizzle a little fresh lemon juice over the flatbreads before serving.
